_about: Public-domain Hugh Martin (1822-1885, Free Church of Scotland minister at Panbride, then Free Greyfriars, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: The Atonement in its Relations to the Covenant, the Priesthood, the Intercession of our Lord (Edinburgh, 1877), The Prophet Jonah (1889), The Westminster Doctrine of the Inspiration of Scripture (1890) and Letters to Marcus Dods (1877), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

hmartin-atonement-1877: The Atonement: in its Relations to the Covenant, the Priesthood, the Intercession of our Lord (Edinburgh: Lyon and Gemmell, 1877)
hmartin-jonah-1889: The Prophet Jonah: his Character and Mission to Nineveh (Edinburgh: J. Gemmell, 1889 reissue; preface dated 1866)
hmartin-westminster-inspiration-1890: The Westminster Doctrine of the Inspiration of Scripture (London: J. Nisbet, 1890)
hmartin-letters-dods-1877: Letters to Marcus Dods (London: J. Nisbet, 1877)

hmartin-jonah-1889.author: the publisher's note reads 'a constant demand for Dr. Huofh Martin's Works' (OCR of Hugh Martin's) and the preface is signed 'H. M.'; checked by eye 2026-10-03
